overview.acquisition_mode: PEAKDETECT (ENV preamble); raw exported record retained; do not use this decimated envelope for PWM duty measurement.

method: PWM: 1.65 V threshold crossings with linear interpolation. DAC: same frozen acquisition as PWM, raw mean/median/range without filtering. Pre-deadband equivalent adds source-configured 300 ns to measured OutA high width; it is an inference.
limits: One frozen capture at each endpoint; not repeatability testing.
Short DAC traces have noise, 0.24 Vpp at maximum and 0.32 Vpp at minimum; nearly flat describes absence of slow triangle change at this time scale, not zero ripple.
Analog triangle and endpoints support positive relationship; this run does not remeasure the whole duty-versus-time curve.
Scope 10x settings read back; physical probe switch, ground, board wiring and calibration not visually inspected.
Screenshot gate uses primary channel; the native CH3 control menu remains visible at right; gate ready=true does not certify absence of this menu.
Source binary identity based on last successful load log and archive SHA-256, not live program-memory readback.
